findings.title: Keep pointer hover focus from scrolling the menu
findings.body: The hover repair calls shared focusItem, which invokes focus() without preventScroll and unconditionally scrollIntoView. Pinned actual Kumo2.6 bundled list navigation focuses with preventScroll:true and clears force-scroll on mouse movement; pointer modality suppresses scrollIntoView. Hovering a partially visible item therefore may move the Native menu scroll position while Source preserves it, interfering with the pointer target. Separate pointer focus from keyboard reveal while retaining real focus/roving tabindex/guarded disabled activation. The transparent Native call observation reaches actual target focus then fails the Source call-value requirement (undefined/1 versus preventScroll:true/0).
